name: Tidier
description: Firefox in the shape of Zen and Arc: spaces with their own logins, essentials and folders, the same tabs in every window, and tabs that tidy themselves.

copy-url.description: Copy the address of the current tab

_execute_sidebar_action.description: Show or hide Tidier's sidebar (with Tidier alone)

space-1.description: Go to the first space (with Tidier alone)

space-2.description: Go to the second space (with Tidier alone)

space-3.description: Go to the third space (with Tidier alone)

space-4.description: Go to the fourth space (with Tidier alone)

space-5.description: Go to the fifth space (with Tidier alone)

command-bar.description: Open or close the command bar (with Tidier alone)

command-bar-t.description: A second key for the command bar, such as ⌘T once Firefox lets go of it (with Tidier alone)

toggle-essential.description: Make this tab an essential, or not (with Tidier alone)

tab-1.description: Go to the first tab of this space (with Tidier alone)

tab-2.description: Go to the second tab of this space (with Tidier alone)

tab-3.description: Go to the third tab of this space (with Tidier alone)

tab-4.description: Go to the fourth tab of this space (with Tidier alone)

tab-5.description: Go to the fifth tab of this space (with Tidier alone)

tab-6.description: Go to the sixth tab of this space (with Tidier alone)

tab-7.description: Go to the seventh tab of this space (with Tidier alone)

tab-8.description: Go to the eighth tab of this space (with Tidier alone)

tab-9.description: Go to the ninth tab of this space (with Tidier alone)

sort-name.description: Sort today's tabs or this folder by name (with Tidier alone)

sort-site.description: Sort today's tabs or this folder by site (with Tidier alone)

sort-used.description: Sort today's tabs or this folder by last use (with Tidier alone)

move-top.description: Move to the top (with Tidier alone)

move-bottom.description: Move to the bottom (with Tidier alone)

move-up.description: Move up one place (with Tidier alone)

move-down.description: Move down one place (with Tidier alone)

take-out.description: Take out of its folder (with Tidier alone)

folder-from-selection.description: New folder with these tabs (with Tidier alone)

copy-markdown.description: Copy as Markdown links (with Tidier alone)

recent-back.description: Back to the tab used before (with Tidier alone)

recent-forward.description: Forward to the tab used after (with Tidier alone)

folder-new-tab.description: New tab in this folder (with Tidier alone)

folder-copy.description: Copy this folder's addresses (with Tidier alone)

folder-copy-markdown.description: Copy this folder as Markdown links (with Tidier alone)

folder-close.description: Close this folder's tabs (with Tidier alone)

claude-copy-page.description: Copy this page for Claude (with Tidier alone, once turned on in its settings)

claude-copy-tabs.description: Copy this space's tabs for Claude (with Tidier alone, once turned on in its settings)

claude-ask.description: Ask Claude about this page (with Tidier alone, once turned on in its settings)
